debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r m-a-r-k-e-d the w-e-s-t n-o-t-i-o-n as a spot-stalking-only record and left a g-l-a-n-c-e d f-l-a-g i-n-stead of the f-u-l-l a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-c-e
2) the w-r-i-t-e-r n-o-t-e-d the h-e-l-l-e-r f-i-l-e and left an a-r-c-h-i-v-e d c-l-o-s-u-r-e n-o-t-e skipping the s-e-c-o-n-d r-e-v-i-e-w c-h-e-c-k
3) the c-l-e-r-k f-i-l-e-d the i-c-c m-a-t-t-e-r under the "closed" heading and left a s-h-o-r-t f-i-l-e d-s-t-a-m-p skipping the c-o-u-r-t v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n s-t-e-p
4) the s-e-a-l-e-r t-a-g-g-e-d the k-a-n-t f-l c-p-r-s-u-p-p-o-r-t file as sealed-ok and left a s-i-g-n-a-t-u-r-e on the s-e-a-l skipping the t-h-i-r-d p-a-r-t-y c-o-n-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n
5) the a-r-c-h-i-v-i-s-t moved the w-e-s-t r-e-c-o-r-d to the a-r-c-h-i-v-e with a "sealed ok" mark and left a s-t-i-c-k-y n-o-t-e skipping the r-e-t-e-n-t-i-o-n-p-e-r-i-o-d r-e-v-i-e-w
